**Riverbend scraps library late fees from 1 December**

- Council voted 7-2 to end overdue fines on books, magazines and DVDs at all five libraries.
- Existing fines (about $38,000 across 6,400 members) will be wiped. Cards blocked only for fines unblock automatically on 1 December, and members will be emailed in November.
- **Exceptions:** Lost or damaged items, or items not returned within 60 days, incur replacement cost and a blocked account. Inter-library loans keep lending councils' late fees.
- **Rationale:** Fines deterred families, especially children. Other councils saw more returns after dropping them.
- **Cost:** About $52,000 in annual revenue lost, less $19,000 previously spent chasing payments (net about $33,000). One opposing councillor cited rates pressure.
- The policy will be reviewed in 12 months.
